verdict.rationale: Linear's Customer Requests docs show feedback capture connected to chat (Asks from shared Slack channels) and support tools (Intercom customer attribute sync, plus a Front integration). The homepage claims conversations and customer feedback become routed issues. No sales tool such as a CRM is evidenced, so only part of the story is covered. Missing for 10: any documented sales-tool (CRM) integration for feedback capture, detail on how Front and Intercom conversations become customer requests, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can connect feedback capture to support, sales, and chat tools I already use

citations.quote: To automatically associate Asks from a shared Slack channel with a customer, open the customer page and choose **Link to Slack channel** from the **…** menu.
Customer attributes such as size and revenue can be synced with and managed from Intercom.
The Front integration now allows multiple labels from multi-select label groups
Automatically turn conversations and customer feedback into actionable issues that are instantly routed, labeled, and prioritized for the right team.
